_comment: Resource-based policy attached to the IAM-authorized COA serve runtime ENDPOINT (in agentops-publisher, 195698601974). This is the SECURITY-CRITICAL boundary for Shape 1: because serve's no-JWT branch TRUSTS profile.groups as asserted by the caller, the IAM-authorized runtime must be reachable by Beacon's role ALONE. If any second, less-trusted principal could invoke it, that principal could assert groups:['Admin'] and escalate. put-resource-policy requires the policy Resource to EQUAL --resource-arn exactly (no wildcards).

Statement._note: Single-principal allow. The <BEACON_AGENT_ROLE_NAME> is the role the beacon-iam-role-policy.json is attached to in the consumer account. No other principal is named, so no other workload can reach this IAM-authorized runtime.
